editorial_thesis: Agents are moving from capability demos toward inspectable operating systems: prove the action, budget the context, and keep personal memory portable.

topic_groups.title: Agent Assurance + Accountability
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A coverage gap: after several days on agent memory and work surfaces, fresh assurance research offers practical controls for proving what agents did, what they were allowed to do, and when harness defenses fail.

sources.title: Verifiable Agent Insurance
sources.usefulness: Add an “evidence required” field to Buildn workflows and client automation briefs.

sources.title: HarnessSecurity-Bench
sources.usefulness: Turn the benchmark mindset into a preflight test for client coding agents and Buildn automation.

sources.title: AgentStripes Maturity Model
sources.usefulness: Use maturity levels in proposals: observable, bounded, recoverable, evaluated, then delegated.

sources.title: Agent Ecology and Population Thresholds
sources.usefulness: For orchestrated client systems, track agent creation rights and cross-agent trust as first-class controls.

sources.title: NVIDIA NemoClaw + OpenShell
sources.usefulness: Evaluate as a reference architecture for private, always-on client assistants.

topic_groups.title: Agent Runtime Efficiency + Context Hygiene
topic_groups.selection_rationale: The ledger has covered memory content; this lane explores the neglected runtime question: when to compact, what to preserve, and how harness complexity changes cost and reliability.

sources.title: Transparent Context Compaction

sources.title: History-Aware Compaction
sources.usefulness: Route compacting by phase: exploration, implementation, review, and handoff each preserve different evidence.

sources.title: SHarP Harness Pruning

sources.title: EvoArena Memory Evolution
sources.usefulness: Add environment-change tests to Buildn agent acceptance criteria.

sources.title: Agent Memory as a Runtime Budget
sources.usefulness: Add a runtime scorecard: tokens retained, compaction count, recovery rate, latency, and cost.

topic_groups.title: Personal Agents + Local-First Memory
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A neglected lane with direct practical value: personal agents are moving toward device-spanning memory, while local-first operation changes privacy, portability, and product design assumptions.
